messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert: canaries failing after blue->green swap in eu-west. error rate >20% across /v1/generate for 5m, latency spike. paging SRE-OnCall :rotating_light:
SRE-OnCall: ack. looking. collecting graphs and canary logs now.
Alex: I see mixed routing - some edge clusters (eu-edge-1) resolving to green backends, eu-edge-2 still to blue. DNS answers differ by resolver/ASN.
Maya: 502s up ~23%, error traces show backend 5xx from `worker-g-02`. p50 latency +180ms.
SRE-OnCall: ops, can you dump the flip job?
OpsBot: flip-job id=789 status=COMPLETED on control-plane, but propagation logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z apply->edge-eu-1 ok
2026-03-15T14:12:07Z apply->edge-eu-2 partial (rate-limited)
2026-03-15T14:12:10Z dns-sync queued for edge-eu-2
```
OpsBot: also seeing short TTL mismatch on `eu.global-redwood.net` (some caches honoring old TTL 300s, others 30s)
Alex: so clients get either blue or green per resolver -> half the traffic hits new green, which is underprovisioned for that subset -> overload + 5xx.
SRE-OnCall: agreed. mitigation options: 1) kill-switch flag to pin eu region back to blue, 2) targeted rollback of flip-job, 3) emergency capacity add to green (slow). Recommend flag first for fastest convergence.
Paul: if we use flag, scope to region:eu-west only. I can apply.
SRE-OnCall: do it. command: `redwoodctl flags set rollout.europe_bluegreen blue --scope region:eu-west --author SRE-OnCall`
OpsBot: flag change applied, propagating to router controllers.
Maya: starting watch: error-rate trending down. currently 502s -> 6% (was 23%). p50 back to +40ms.
SupportLead: drafting customer comms. status page update: "We are mitigating a traffic routing issue affecting users in EU. Some requests may see errors or increased latency. Mitigation in progress." Sending to #support for triage.
ProductSafety: any PII/exposure concerns?
Alex: no evidence of data leakage; failures are 5xx from worker overload.
SRE-OnCall: OpsBot, can you confirm DNS TTL normalization plan?
OpsBot: plan: push consistent TTL 60s across all edge resolvers and kick cache-invalidation job for major public resolvers. will schedule now.
Maya: metrics show error rate under 1.5% after flag for last 2m. Latency stable.
SRE-OnCall: good. initiating brief postmortem runbook. handoff: @Alex you'll own the PM with me as reviewer. I'm going off-call in 30m, but reachable.
Alex: ack, starting timeline capture.
Paul: notes for root cause: (a) flip-job propagation race + rate-limit on edge-eu-2, (b) DNS TTL heterogeneity causing mixed routing, (c) capacity assumptions for green didn't account for subset hot-path.
SRE-OnCall: immediate action items:
- revert region via rollout flag (done)
- force TTL unify to 60s and kick cache invalidation (ops)
- add pre-check to flip job to verify edge controllers are in sync before finalize
- run load test against green scaled to 2x before next canary
- Update runbook to include regional kill-switch command examples
SupportLead: customer follow-up: create broadcast for impacted accounts and log incident in support tracker.
ProductSafety: add evaluation of any retries that may have duplicated requests as part of QA.
Maya: uploading graphs + sample traces to the incident doc: https://redwood/internal/incidents/2600004321 (draft)
SRE-OnCall: wrapping. final status: mitigation succeeded, traffic pinned to blue for eu-west, errors returned to baseline. Will open postmortem and schedule blameless review. thanks everyone :tada:
Alex: handing primary ownership for postmortem. I'll capture timeline and checks.
IncidentBot: incident P1 closed (mitigated).
